contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Laser Hair Reduction in Ghaziabad & Noida

Permanent reduction of unwanted hair — for all skin tones.

Thick and long hair excessively growing everywhere on the body tends to look shabby, more so, in women when compared to men. Good news is that the hair growth can be drastically reduced with the help of an advanced modality known as laser hair reduction. Time to get rid of unwanted hair in a few sessions and save a few bucks that you would spend on visiting a salon once in a month or buying a razor.

Laser hair reduction in Noida is trusted and popular after several patients have successfully achieved hair-free skin. You can achieve similar results once you choose a medically knowledgeable professional to do a laser hair reduction treatment . At Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic, you are assured of experiencing globally recognized laser treatments with promising long-term results of hair-free skin without any hassles of discomfort.

At present, Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic is a leading laser hair removal clinic in Noida. We are offering tailored treatment plans using advanced equipment and evidence-based treatments to derive maximum hair-free results for every single patient. Right from treating a section of your skin to opting for hair reduction for the entire body, our experienced dermatologists are dedicated to showing undivided attention and care.

LASER HAIR REDUCTION

What is Laser Hair Reduction?

The process of making use of light to target hair follicles to either reduce or completely stop unwanted hair growth. This laser hair reduction method is medically proven right. Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic does a good laser hair reduction treatment with utmost precision, zero risk, and assuring results on India skin tones. For the most part, diode laser hair reduction is used at this clinic.

The pigment present in the hair roots absorbs emitted beam light. This light slowly destroys every follicle while keeping the skin around safe. It takes multiple sessions for reduction in hair growth and attaining soft skin. Not much maintenance is required either.

When compared to threading or waxing, laser hair reduction is cleaner, less-invasive, and promises long-term benefits, this method is certainly one of the best laser hair removal methods in the present scenario.

KEY BENEFITS

Benefits of Laser Hair Reduction

Laser hair reduction has potential and gained immense popularity over the years. Today convenience is all that we seek, and dermatologists have come up with this treatment method to provide results with utmost comfort.

01

Effective Long-Lasting Results

A good laser hair reduction treatment focuses on reducing most of the hair volume. At times, depending on the individual, hair removal changes are noticeable and long lasting when compared to a few others. However, in general, it provides long term results.

02

Suitable For All Skin Types

At our clinic we provide lasers friendly on sensitive skin as well. To double-check on the safety aspect, our dermatologists personalize the treatment based on every patient’s skin type. They offer certain adjustments while setting things up.

03

Provides Detailed Results

Dark and thick hair is targeted through diode laser. Not a bit of the surrounding skin is affected. This type of laser is suitable for hair removal on areas such as the bikini, face, and underarms.

04

Fast & Smooth Experience

Men and women today can make the most of getting a hair removal without any hassles of struggling with pain. This method of hair removal even includes cooling technology that provides complete comfort. The sessions don’t take long - quite a time-saving technique.

05

Effective On The Entire Body

Laser hair reduction works on the entire body, right from the arms to the under-arms. You won't notice any major difference on any part. Results are similar irrespective of the body part.

06

Eliminates Ingrown Hair

With a detailed laser hair reduction treatment, you will no longer witness any ingrown hair or bumps. The skin feels completely free of hair.

07

Pocket-Friendly

In a few sessions all the hair is easily eliminated through laser hair reduction, besides it is even reasonably priced. However, waxing or threading requires to be done constantly and is comparatively costlier than laser.

Also Read - How to Choose the Best Laser Hair Reduction Treatment →
TREATMENT PLAN

How Many Sessions Are Needed?

The basic hair growth happens gradually in different stages. Therefore, with laser hair reduction, a few sessions are required to see drastic results.

Based on every part of the body, sessions required for laser hair reduction vary. In general:

Face 12 Sessions
Under-arms 8 Sessions
Legs & Arms 10 Sessions
Full Body 8 Sessions
Bikini Line 8 Sessions

Considering every patient’s hormonal factors, once or twice a year, touch-up might be required. It is essential to get treated from a reputable laser hair removal clinic in Noida like Reviva Skin & Surgery. A reliable place will always assure reduction in hair growth and drastic improvement after every session.

CARE GUIDE

Pre- & Post-Care Instructions

Always follow the simple care instructions provided by your dermatologist to benefit from the treatment and long-term results. Here are some pre and post care instructions to keep in mind:

01

Pre-Care

  • 4 weeks before the session, do not wax or pluck hair.
  • Resort to shaving the area to be treated 24 hours in prior.
  • A week before, don’t expose yourself a lot to sunlight.
  • Stay away from perfumes or makeup before the session.
  • Keep the dermatologist informed if you are on medication.
02

Post-Care

  • Commit to using dermatologist prescribed cream.
  • For 2 days, strictly avoid hot showers or steam.
  • Stay sweat-free for two days, don’t hit the gym in case you do.
  • Use SPF 30+ regularly for protecting your skin.
  • Shaving can be done after the sessions, avoid waxing or threading.
WHY REVIVA

Why Choose Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic?

Best reasons for delivering excellence in laser hair reduction:

01

Expert Professionals For Laser Hair Reduction in Noida

Every single procedure is closely monitored and treated by an experienced dermatologist. At our clinic, we have our specialized doctor Aarushi Tyagi known for rendering cosmetic treatment with ultimate precision. Generally, for laser hair reduction in Noida one needs to always see a health professional who has not just knowledge, but even experience in cases.

Our doctor is dedicated to ensure a patient’s safety, diagnose the problem accurately, and gently perform the procedure customized to what is good for the patient and his/her needs.

02

Cutting-Edge Diode Laser Technology

Our doctor chooses diode laser systems approved by the FDA. In addition, it has cooling technology as well. Through our procedures, we ensure to provide maximum comfort, efficiency, quick sessions, and exceptional results for Indian skin.

03

Personalized Treatment Plans

There are several factors that determine hair growth. In the case of laser hair reduction, to come up with an effective treatment plan, our dermatologist designs a treatment option after evaluating the patient’s hair type, hormonal activity, skin color, and density. Every patient’s scenario is given detailed attention and the best plan is accordingly made.

OUR PATIENTS

Universally Trusted
(By both Women & Men Across Noida)

The clinic provides long-lasting hair reduction benefits and the general public trust in us. Our patients are homemakers, brides-to-be, working professionals, people into sports etc who get their treatment done.

TREATMENT PRICING

Cost Factors

Certain factors such as the area to be treated, hair volume, density, type of skin, type of laser, and the frequency of sessions needed determines the cost of a laser hair reduction in Noida.

While many patients curiously look for full body laser hair reduction cost Noida, here’s an estimate/price range per session, but not the precise cost of the treatment:

Full Body Laser ₹12,000 – ₹15,000
Bikini Area ₹3,000 – ₹4,000
Upper Lip or Chin ₹1,000 – ₹2,000
Underarms ₹1,500 – ₹3,000
Arms or Legs ₹3,000 – ₹8,000
GET IN TOUCH

Connect With Us

Check out our official website Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic Noida and connect with us today. We’ve got your back to assist you transition from a body filled with hair to not much hair with long lasting results.

Laser hair reduction is pocket friendly and offers long-lasting results from unwanted hair. At our clinic we stick by high standards and hygiene to ensure our patients feel safe and comfortable.

Visit Reviva Skin & Surgery →

Frequently Asked Questions

Laser hair reduction - is it permanent?
+
Laser hair reduction works on the depth of a hair follicle with laser light. For a long time no hair grows back, but it does after a while due to changes in hormones. Therefore, it does not permanently stop hair growth, but provides no-hair results for a long time.
How many sessions are required for laser hair removal?
+
Based on hair density, area of the body, skin and hair contrast, you will need around 10 sessions for laser hair removal.
Is laser hair removal safe for all skin types?
+
At Reviva Skin & Surgery, we use diode lasers tailored to different skin tones, proving to be effective and safe for many patients.
What is the cost of laser hair removal in Ghaziabad?
+
The cost will be based on the technology used and the area where the clinic is located. By and large, keep aside 40K for a session in Ghaziabad. This still varies, it is not the exact cost in this area.
Does laser hair reduction hurt?
+
The procedure is negligibly painful. As experts use cooling technology, the patient does not feel any discomfort.
Can men also get laser hair removal?
+
It is totally normal for men to get a laser hair removal done. Usually, they choose either full-body laser hair reduction or on the beard, chest, or back.
